system:
You are a promo editor for vertical microdramas (ReelShort/DramaBox style).
You pick which seconds of an episode become a 20-60 second advert for the show.

A good promo:
- opens on a hook: within its first beats, something that stops a scrolling viewer - a slap, a reveal, a shocking line
- ends on a cliffhanger: it stops at an unresolved moment, so the viewer must go find the show
- makes sense alone to someone who has never seen this show

You will be given candidate windows, each a contiguous run of beats labelled [b00], [b01]...
You must choose ONE window and may tighten its edges to any beat labels inside that window.

Reply with JSON only:
{
  "chosen_window": <integer index of the window you picked>,
  "start_beat": "<beat label>",
  "end_beat": "<beat label>",
  "hook_beat": "<beat label, must be at or within 2 beats of start_beat>",
  "cliffhanger_beat": "<beat label, must be at or near end_beat>",
  "hook": "<what grabs the viewer in the first seconds, one sentence>",
  "cliffhanger": "<the unresolved moment it cuts on, one sentence>",
  "hook_type": "<one of: moral outrage, romantic tension, empathy shock, power reversal>",
  "why_it_works": "<one sentence, concrete, no marketing language>",
  "standalone_risk": "<what a new viewer would NOT understand, or 'none'>"
}

Never invent dialogue. Never output a time or a duration - only beat labels.
prompt:
Episode 1. 4 candidate windows, already checked for legal length and real beat boundaries.

--- WINDOW 0 (24 seconds, code score 0.88) ---
[b00] JULIANA (outraged, accusing): "You knew this before I walked through those doors!"
[b01] JULIANA (choking on tears): "You let me come here..."
[b02] JULIANA (crushed, shaking): "You let me dress in my mother's gown..."
[b03] JULIANA (crying out): "You let me believe I was walking toward my husband!"
[b04] GERALD (cold, callous): "I changed my mind."
[b05] JULIANA (betrayed, piercing): "You swore you loved me!"
[b06] CLARISSA (mocking): "People change their minds, sister."
[b07] JULIANA (horrified): "And you knew?"

--- WINDOW 1 (38 seconds, code score 0.82) ---
[b00] JULIANA (horrified): "And you knew?"
[b01] CLARISSA (unapologetic, cheerful): "Of course I knew."
[b02] JULIANA (trembling): "How long?"
[b03] CLARISSA (cruel, poised): "Long enough to know he was never going to marry you."
[b04] ACTION: Juliana turns abruptly toward the first row of pews, where her elderly father sits gripping an ornate brass cane.
[b05] JULIANA (desperate): "Father..."
[b06] JULIANA (begging): "Tell them this is a mistake."
[b07] JULIANA (choking, broken): "Father... please look at me."
[b08] ACTION: The father tightens his jaw and stony expression, refusing to offer a single word or look.
[b09] MATRIARCH (stern, resolute): "Enough!"
[b10] MATRIARCH (disgusted): "You have embarrassed this family long enough."
[b11] JULIANA (incredulous): "Embarrassed you?"
[b12] MATRIARCH (haughty): "Clarissa knows how to carry herself."
[b13] MATRIARCH (proud): "She has beauty, connections, and a future worth protecting."
[b14] JULIANA (raw, painful): "And I am what?"

--- WINDOW 2 (36 seconds, code score 0.77) ---
[b00] JULIANA (confused, breathless): "Why?"
[b01] JULIANA (desperate, unbelieving): "Gerald is waiting for me."
[b02] MATRIARCH (blunt, unforgiving): "Not anymore."
[b03] JULIANA (trembling, pleading): "What do you mean?"
[b04] MATRIARCH (dismissive): "Look for yourself."
[b05] ACTION: Juliana walks forward past the Matriarch, her breath hitching as she approaches the altar steps, looking up in shock.
[b06] JULIANA (shaken, whispering): "Gerald?"
[b07] JULIANA (heartbroken): "Why are you holding her hand?"
[b08] CLARISSA (gloating, smug): "Because he is marrying me."
[b09] JULIANA (gasping, devastated): "No..."
[b10] JULIANA (outraged, accusing): "You knew this before I walked through those doors!"

--- WINDOW 3 (26 seconds, code score 0.73) ---
[b00] JULIANA (raw, painful): "And I am what?"
[b01] CLARISSA (viciously calm): "You are the daughter people tolerate because they have to."
[b02] CLARISSA (gloating): "I am the daughter they choose."
[b03] MATRIARCH (firm): "Clarissa is the jewel of this family."
[b04] JULIANA (trembling, dignified): "So that is what I was worth to you?"
[b05] GERALD (scornful, hard): "You have nothing to offer me anymore."
[b06] GERALD (arrogant, dismissive): "I cannot marry a woman of such plainness and low value..."
[b07] GERALD (reverent toward clarissa): "...when Clarissa is the true jewel of the county."

Pick the single best promo.
